entries.title: Before We Leave
entries.definitive_edition: Before We Leave on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: Before We Leave launched first on PC before later Mac and console releases, and the Steam release supports the usual PC settings/achievement route. No platform-exclusive gameplay is known, so Windows PC is the highest-fidelity and most-complete version to play.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC release on Steam, Epic Games Store, or the Windows/Xbox PC store.

all_releases.fidelity: Native Windows PC release; first launched on Epic Games Store, later on Steam and Windows Store.
all_releases.reason: primary: highest-fidelity route and no sourced exclusive content elsewhere.
skip: no exclusive content; use Windows PC unless Mac is the required local platform.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: There is no platform-exclusive gameplay content; PC remains both highest-fidelity and complete.

entries.remaster_caveats: The Deluxe Edition/Complete the Set bundles add soundtrack content rather than a gameplay remaster or exclusive mission content.
